prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence for specific kinds of changes is still thin, as each category has only one completed test so far.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured results.
No clear effect was seen for reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder).
No clear effect was seen for introducing new flows on the home screen (home, new_flow).
No clear effect was seen for redesigning pet selection cards (adoption, redesign).
Redesigning the finish step (finish, redesign) significantly hurt performance.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -5.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Interactive Story Introduction Split Layout: Redesign the initial story screen into a split layout showcasing an animated pet mascot reacting on the desktop to immediately set expectations. (why: The choose_path step loses 23.8% of users right at the beginning and has a long mean duration of 514s.)
1: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Option Time Estimate: Add an explicit time estimate display and helpful hint on the path selection screen. (why: Median time spent on choose_path is 8s while mean time is 514s, indicating significant user hesitation or idle drop-off.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence and Sync Warning Note: Add a prominent hint warning users to sign in with their main account to lock in pet data and prevent accidental pet resets. (why: Support received 8 separate tickets reporting pets missing or reset after signing back into the app.)
3: [sign_in, layout] Compact Sign In Screen Layout: Reframe the sign-in screen using a compact layout focus to reduce visual clutter and prevent sign-in stalling. (why: Sign-in loses 27.1% of onboarding users with a high mean completion time of 567s and bug reports of screen stalls.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Spawn Status Notification Switch: Turn on ready notifications on the waiting screen so users get alerted when their pet successfully renders on the desktop screen. (why: Users report that pets fail to show up on desktop or app stalls, leading to home median wait of 201s and high mean wait.)
5: [home, new_screen] Desktop Preparation Progress Screen: Add a dedicated desktop environment initialization screen with dynamic progress bar while waiting for asset generation. (why: The waiting/home step drops 18.7% of users and has an extreme mean time of 2336s.)
6: [finish, hint] Quick Control Tips on Welcome Intro: Add clear guidance hints directly on home_intro explaining basic mouse shortcuts to interact with or minimize the desktop pet. (why: 35.2% drop off at finish step and support emails highlight post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide pets.)

Strong support ticket evidence backed by quick config hint change.

Notification config change addressing reported rendering stalls.

High impact step supported by emails, implemented via safe hints.
